about: Одна партия — много названий: семьи брендов, у которых одна партия Metrc (A), один сертификат (B), один урожай Metrc по имени урожая с карточки (G, harvests), одна производственная партия sourceBatch (H, productionBatches; код прогона фасовки — только watch) или одна полная панель терпенов (C) стоит под разными названиями; C' (nearPanels) — почти одинаковые панели, только watch: kind near или templated (шаблонные панели одного переработчика, evidence — почему); D (тот же THC, сверх случайного) и E (коды UPC при одном THC) — подтверждающие и слабые сигналы; статусы confirmed / probable / watch. excluded — что не в счёт (шаблоны магазинов, переписанные панели). oldTests — производства, упаковывающие цветок через 90+ дней после теста. cards — карточки Retail ID с цифрами (свой кэш, 404 переспрашивается через 30 дней, старые карточки вне случаев худеют; --import-cards ввозит скачанные сырые карточки), probing — что спрошено в этот прогон. recalls — пакеты, отозванные по карточке; impossibleDates — карточки с датами, которых не бывает; verified у случая и review у партии — ручные вердикты из data/lot-twins-reviews.json. Пишется scripts/lot-twins.py после ежедневного прогона.

cases.producer: Pierre McClain LLC + Harlem Blossoms LLC

review.note: Metrc batch 1A41203000026BA000000012 is sold as Cherry Runtz and as 03' Sour x Runrz (sic, the cards' spelling). Package 26BA…002 (Cherry Runtz 3.5g; Pierre McClain LLC; packaged 2025-10-28) is the source of …817 (Cherry Runtz 3.5g; packaged 2026-04-06), of …863 (strain 03' Sour x Runrz, product still 'Cherry Runtz 3.5g'; packaged 2026-06-07) and of …872 (03' Sour x Runrz; Pierre McClain LLC OCM-MICR-25-000246-DX1; packaged 2026-06-11): the name changed when …002 was repacked, and …863's own card carries both names. One certificate: Keystone, tested 2025-10-21, THC 25.97%, β-caryophyllene 0.2938, β-myrcene 0.2878, linalool 0.2705, limonene 0.2439; TestPassed; none on recall. Package …872 is also printed in Good Money's certificate link coa/30964.pdf, a saved Retail ID page. Not established: which name is the plant's, or whether any rule was broken.

Metrc batch 1A41203000026BA000000014 is sold under three names. From source package 26BA…013 (no public card, 404): …819 Candy Gelato (product SCC201; manufacturer Pierre McClain LLC; facility Harlem Blossoms LLC; packaged 2026-04-06) and …870 Zeven Up (Pierre McClain LLC OCM-MICR-25-000246-DX1; packaged 2026-06-11). From …819: …583 The Wrap Up (product SCC201-TWU; Harlem Blossoms LLC; packaged 2026-05-28). One certificate on all three: Keystone, tested 2025-10-28, THC 26.1%, β-myrcene 0.4265, limonene 0.4226, linalool 0.3408, β-caryophyllene 0.302, terpineol 0.1031; TestPassed; none on recall. Lot Twins' cache also holds …581 (Candy Gelato, 2026-03-06) and …860 (Zeven Up, product SCC201, 2026-06-07) of this batch. Package …870 is printed in Good Money's 'Zeven Up' certificate links (coa/30902.pdf, coa/30965.pdf), which are saved Retail ID pages of that package: the shelf's own link to the batch. Not established: which name is the plant's, or whether any rule was broken.

Metrc batch 1A41203000026BA000000042 is sold as Blue Dream, Gelato 41 and Zowah. Package …823 (Blue Dream, product SCC350; manufacturer Pierre McClain LLC OCM-MICR-25-000246-P1; facility Harlem Blossoms LLC OCM-MICR-24-000040-DX1; packaged 2026-04-06) was made from 26BA…041, which has no public card (404). Packages …582 and …586 (Gelato 41, product SCC350-G41; Harlem Blossoms LLC; packaged 2026-05-27 and 2026-05-28) name …823 as their source package: the name changed when the Blue Dream package was repacked. Packages …869, …877, …878 and …879 (Zowah; Pierre McClain LLC; packaged 2026-06-11; …869 read here, the others from Lot Twins' cache) were made from 26BA…041 too. One certificate throughout: Keystone State Testing (OCM-CPL-24-00007-L1), tested 2025-12-22, THC 24.16%, eleven identical analytes; TestPassed; none on recall. The equal chemistry is that one certificate shown on each card, not an independent match. Good Money's 'Zowah' shelf lot (five shops) prints the same panel; its certificate link coa/37885.pdf is a saved Retail ID page without its package block. Not established: which name is the plant's, or whether any rule was broken.
